name: Team Finance arbitrary-pair migration drain
summary: LockToken.migrate() authorized the caller using one lock ID but accepted a separate caller-supplied Uniswap V2 pair and liquidity amount. The attacker used locks for a worthless self-made token to migrate other users' locked LP balances into attacker-controlled Uniswap V3 positions.
notes: The last of seven pre-incident Upgraded events selected the implementation that introduced the vulnerable Uniswap V2-to-V3 migration path.

The $14.5 million value is the contemporaneous reported incident aggregate. The listed quantities reproduce the anchor transaction's final attacker-controlled balances: ETH from the attack contract state diff and DAI, CAW, and TSUKA from receipt transfers. The DAI was obtained by swapping the stolen USDC inside the same transaction.
The $14.5 million USD value is reported; the exact onchain quantities are retained without per-token USD allocations.
